meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude 可调用 Exa 搜索引擎完成网络搜索，能按研究论文类别过滤学术内容；还能批量抓取并提取网页、文章或学术 PDF 的正文内容。
howto.when: 当用户提出搜索查找、抓取网页或提取文章内容等请求时触发；需要按研究论文类别做学术筛选时也会调用。

say.text: 搜索关于可控核聚变的最新研究论文，带标题和链接。
say.note: 将偏向学术来源并返回论文结果。

say.text: 把这个网页的正文内容提取出来并总结要点。
say.note: 会调用 URL 提取而不是内置抓取。

say.text: 批量提取这几个链接的文章内容。
say.note: 一次调用可处理多个 URL。

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude can run web searches via the Exa API, optionally filtered by academic research-paper category, and extract content from URLs, including webpages, articles, and academic PDFs in batch.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to search, fetch a page, or extract content from URLs, or when scholarly filtering is preferred.

say_en.text: Search for recent research papers on controlled fusion, with titles and links.
say_en.note: Uses Exa search tuned toward scholarly sources.

say_en.text: Extract the main content of this webpage and summarize key points.
say_en.note: Calls URL extraction instead of built-in fetch.

say_en.text: Batch-extract the articles from these links.
say_en.note: Handles multiple URLs in a single call.
